title: Giant progenitor comet behind the Taurid meteor stream

tellings.quote: 25 to 30,000 years ago a gigantic comet maybe 50 to 60 mi diameter nucleus or even bigger came it was captured into a a sub jovian orbit

plain: Some 25,000 to 30,000 years ago a gigantic comet, with a core perhaps 50 to 60 miles across or larger, was captured into an orbit inside Jupiter's, and the Taurid meteor stream, a yearly meteor shower, comes from it. A researcher of ancient catastrophes named Randall Carlson tells Michels this, drawing on the astronomers Victor Clube and William Napier and on William Asher. If true, Earth has long been passing through the debris of one huge comet.
